title: The operation names of the rwb-payment proceeds and vendor-fee read, the rwb-case case-move answer and the rwb-source-data account and sale data product are not published
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md (slides 19, 20, 41, 43); _work/msr/plan/ownership.json; Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (T-A.1)
section: s3 Preconditions; s12.2 REST operations consumed; s12.8 Contract fakes; s13 Solution plan
description: The application story consumes four rows across three owners and no source document publishes the operation name of any of them. Architecture v5 slide 19 gives rwb-asset the consumed event ProceedsMatched but names no proceeds read and no case-move operation; the Ownership Map carries the four S5 rows only; TSD S5 T-A.1 lists this service's own operations and no neighbour's. The story therefore builds against a documented use and a placeholder, not a path.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 19 IN lists JudgmentRecorded, AuctionResult, ProceedsMatched and PartnerResultSubmitted for rwb-asset and names no REST operation of P3, P8 or P1; slide 41 gives rwb-asset ownership of assets, holding, floor price, listings and auction rounds and names no proceeds read; the Ownership Map API rows for S5 are GET /assets, GET /assets/{assetId}, POST /assets/{assetId}/listings and POST /listings/{listingId}/rounds only.
owner_role: P3 rwb-case owner, P8 rwb-payment owner, P1 rwb-source-data owner
proposed: Each owner publishes the operation name of its row before the wave 3 tag, and RWB-S5-E4030-CON replaces the placeholder with the published name in a minor version.

title: No source names the table and column that hold the residual and its D9 hand-off, and the vendor-fee match is not assigned to a service
source: Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (T3.1 tables, T3.2 lists, T3.3 relationships); Recovery Workbench FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 (A2.21); _work/msr/plan/ownership.json; legacy RWB-E4-030 Data table
section: s4 Flow steps 9 and 10; s8 BR3, BR5; s11 Data; s13 Configuration and reference data
description: Legacy AC2 raises the residual for the D9 decision and legacy AC3 matches the vendor fee, but neither the TSD S5 T3.1 tables nor the FSD A2.21 names a column for the residual or a table for its hand-off, and no source assigns the vendor-fee match to this service or to rwb-payment. The story writes the sale outcome on asset_sale and records the residual against the same row where a column exists, and it reads the vendor-fee match as rwb-payment's fact because the fee and its posting sit with the money; both readings are assumptions and neither is a value invented here.
evidence: TSD S5 T3.1 lists the asset and sale tables and names no shortfall or residual table; the legacy Data table lists proceeds under DF-FIN-001 to DF-FIN-009 and no residual entity; FSD S5 A2.21 states the outcome without naming the store; the Ownership Map gives proceeds to P8 and asset_sale to S5 with no residual row.
owner_role: S5 rwb-asset owner with P8 rwb-payment owner; P3 rwb-case owner for the D9 routing
proposed: The S5 data owner confirms the residual column on asset_sale or names the rwb-writeoff store, and the P8 owner confirms the vendor-fee match as its own fact; the DB story of the service adds the column in its own Flyway sequence if it does not exist.

title: The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice
source: _work/msr/plan (story and requirement rows); Recovery Workbench FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 (A2.21, FEAT-AST-21); Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Program v4
section: s2 Business rationale; s18 Traceability requirement table
description: The story serves FEAT-AST-21 of the FSD module S5, and the split plan's requirement rows carry no id for this slice, so the traceability table states the requirement by its feature and cites this gap instead of an invented REQ id.
evidence: The plan's requirement rows for rwb-asset do not include a row for the proceeds and shortfall slice; the FSD S5 A2.21 names FEAT-AST-21 without a REQ id in this slice's scope.
proposed: The requirement owner allocates a REQ id for the slice at the next plan revision and the traceability row is repointed without a story change.

title: No source names a published operation for the proceeds and shortfall step itself, and no element is defined for the residual in the contract
source: _work/msr/plan/ownership.json (S5 API rows); 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md (slides 19, 41); Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (T-A.1)
section: CON s7 C4; s9 In review; s11 Data; s12.1 REST operations provided; s12.2; s12.7
description: The contract baseline must declare the surface of the step, and the only S5 operations the Ownership Map publishes are the four asset and listing rows. No source names an operation that exposes the proceeds and shortfall step, and no source defines a contract element for the residual. The baseline declares the two asset reads that answer the screens, declares the step's own operation as None with this gap, and declares the residual element only when its owner names the column.
evidence: The Ownership Map API rows for S5 are GET /assets, GET /assets/{assetId}, POST /assets/{assetId}/listings and POST /listings/{listingId}/rounds; TSD S5 T-A.1 names no proceeds operation; Architecture v5 slide 19 gives rwb-asset an inbound event and two outbound events and no operation for the step.
proposed: The service owner confirms at the tag whether the step exposes any operation; if it does, this baseline adds it in a minor version with its rights and its error set.

title: The split plan carries no requirement id for the contract slice and the Ownership Map table list omits the asset row
source: _work/msr/plan (story and requirement rows); _work/msr/plan/ownership.json (table rows); 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md (slides 19, 41); Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (T3.1)
section: CON s3 Preconditions; s11 Data; s18 Traceability requirement table
description: Two documentation gaps meet in the contract slice. The plan's requirement rows carry no id for this slice, so the traceability table cites the feature and this gap. The Ownership Map table list gives asset_sale and listing to S5 and omits asset, which slides 19 and 41 and TSD S5 T3.1 read as S5; the baseline names asset as S5 on that reading and records it here rather than in an invented row.
evidence: The plan's requirement rows carry no row for the proceeds and shortfall slice; the Ownership Map table rows list asset_sale and listing under S5 and carry no asset row; Architecture v5 slide 41 and TSD S5 T3.1 treat the asset record as rwb-asset's.
owner_role: Program requirements owner and the Ownership Map maintainer
proposed: The requirement owner allocates a REQ id at the next plan revision and the Ownership Map adds the asset row to S5's table list; neither change alters a story shape.
